Chameleon Blend in with the shadows! Camouflage to sneakily get around and gather info! Use your Camouflage ability to turn invisible and gather information. The Chameleon is a Crewmate Investigative role that can use their ability to temporarily turn invisible to all other players. During the time that they are invisible, the Chameleon will get a speed boost, and if settings allow, the ability to vent. Idea by mystic_haze2 Camouflage Camouflage to turn invisible. While invisible, you gain a speed boost and will be able to vent if settings allow.

Decryptor Decrypt and decieve! Complete tasks to reveal the letters of players' roles. Complete tasks to reveal letters of the roles that players spawned with, and decrypt the scrambled codes. The Decryptor is a Crewmate Investigative role that can complete tasks to slowly reveal the letters in players' original roles. If settings allow, evils may be alerted of the Decryptor's presence. The Decryptor only decrypts the roles players spawned into the game with, not necessarily what they currently are.
You have revealed a letter of everyone's role! The Decryptor is finding out your true identity, stop them! Evils now know of your presence!
Number Of Tasks For Letter Reveal Alert Evils Of Decryptor Number Of Letters Revealed For Evil Alert
Auditor Work against the Crew! Use your abilities to work against Crewmates. Work with evils to stop the Crew from winning! The Auditor is a Neutral Outlier role that must work against the Crew to win the game. Smokebomb Smokebomb all players within your vicinity. You will reveal information about every player caught in your smokebomb. Smokebombing a player once gives you their alignment, twice gives you their subalignment, and three times gives you their role. Audit Roleblock a player temporarily.
You were smokebombed by the Auditor! You were audited by the Auditor and cannot use your abilities!
